relationships.relation_statement: Require each of the three input conics itself to be an ordinary circle. This gives Apollonius input data inside the three-conic input space.
relationships.evidence_location: Definition of circles as conics through the two circular points; Section 2.1, with the separately recorded Apollonius quadratic count.
relationships.inheritance_policy: Input inclusion only. The generic 184-circle count and generic monodromy do not transfer: the ordinary Apollonius problem has degree 8, and its compactification/admissibility conventions are different. Use its own result records.
relationships.caveats: Elementary inclusion of the specified input classes. Regular versus exceptional restriction status is not classified here; this relation authorizes no automatic inheritance.
